info.title: API.SH: iNaturalist
info.description: The iNaturalist API from API.SH: public iNaturalist data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Observation counts over time for any observation filter: by year, month, week, day or hour, or seasonally by month of year or week of year. Same filters as /inaturalist/v1/observations.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-histogram

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One observation with everything public: taxon and community taxon, date and time, place and coordinates (obscured where required), quality grade and metrics, photos and sounds with licence, annotations, observation fields, tags, projects, every identification (taxon, category, comment) and comment. People appear as on their public profiles (`user_profile`: username, display name, avatar, ORCID), with the photo credit lines and the people who faved it (`faved_by`). The true coordinates of an obscured observation are never returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-observation

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Observation id or an inaturalist.org/observations link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Nature observations with the site's filters (taxon, place, project, observer, quality grade, dates, area, annotations, media, licence...): date, taxon with common name and conservation status, place, coordinates (obscured where the observer or taxon requires), quality grade, photos and sounds with licence, annotations and observation fields. Observers appear as on their public profile (username, display name, avatar, ORCID); photos and sounds carry their credit line. The true coordinates of obscured observations are never returned. The site serves the first 10,000 matches of a query. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-observations

parameters.name: taxon_name
parameters.description: Scientific or common name, e.g. `Danaus plexippus`.

parameters.name: iconic_taxa
parameters.description: Plantae, Aves, Insecta, Fungi, Mammalia, Reptilia, Amphibia, Actinopterygii, Mollusca, Arachnida, Animalia, Protozoa, Chromista, unknown.

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: Observation licence(s): cc0, cc-by, cc-by-nc, cc-by-sa, cc-by-nd, cc-by-nc-sa, cc-by-nc-nd.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The usernames with the most observations (or species) for any observation filter, with their observation and species counts and public profile (`user_profile`: display name, avatar, ORCID). Same filters as /inaturalist/v1/observations. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-observers

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Rank by observation or species count.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-place

parameters.name: id

get.description:
iNaturalist places (countries, states, counties, parks, community-made areas) by name, or the standard and community places around a point: id, name, type, admin level, ancestors and centre. Use the id as `place_id` in the observation routes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-places

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-project

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Project id, slug or an inaturalist.org/projects link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Which species were observed, with how many observations each, for any observation filter (a place, a project, an observer, a date range, an area...). Takes the same filters as /inaturalist/v1/observations. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-species-counts

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Taxa (species and every other rank) by scientific or common name, by parent or by rank: id, name, rank, common name, iconic group, observation count, default photo, Wikipedia link and ancestry ids. `autocomplete=true` gives the site's type-ahead matches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-taxa

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Common names in this language (e.g. es).

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description: Common names preferred in this place.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One taxon in full: name, rank, common name, Wikipedia summary, full ancestry and direct children, names in every language, conservation statuses by place and authority (IUCN and national lists), establishment (native, introduced, endemic) by place, photos with licence and observation count.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-taxon

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Taxon id or an inaturalist.org/taxa link.

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description: Common name preferred in this place.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One public iNaturalist profile by username, numeric id or profile link: username, display name, avatar, ORCID, bio, roles (curator...), join date and last active day, observation, species, identification, annotation and journal-post counts, and monthly-supporter flag. Their observations come from /inaturalist/v1/observations with `user`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/inaturalist-user

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: iNaturalist username, numeric user id or an inaturalist.org/people link.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
